ddl.name: ssh_branch_access_state_check
ddl.value:
(
          (
            "state" = 'enabled'
            AND "block_reason" IS NULL
            AND "enabled_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "state" = 'blocked'
            AND "block_reason" IS NOT NULL
            AND "blocked_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
        )

ddl.name: ssh_branch_access_timestamp_check
ddl.value:
(
          "enabled_at" IS NULL
          OR "enabled_at" >= "created_at"
        )
        AND
        (
          "blocked_at" IS NULL
          OR "blocked_at" >= "created_at"
        )

ddl.name: ssh_branch_grants_state_check
ddl.value:
(
          (
            "status" = 'active'
            AND "revoked_at" IS NULL
            AND "revoked_by_user_id" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "status" = 'revoked'
            AND "revoked_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
        )

ddl.name: ssh_branch_grants_timestamp_check
ddl.value: "revoked_at" IS NULL OR "revoked_at" >= "created_at"

ddl.name: ssh_public_keys_state_check
ddl.value:
(
          (
            "status" = 'active'
            AND "revoked_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "status" = 'revoked'
            AND "revoked_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
        )

ddl.name: ssh_public_keys_fingerprint_check
ddl.value: "fingerprint" ~ '^SHA256:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{43}$'

ddl.name: ssh_public_keys_blob_check
ddl.value: length("public_key_blob") BETWEEN 1 AND 16384

ddl.name: ssh_public_keys_label_check
ddl.value:
(
          "label" IS NULL
          OR (
            length(btrim("label")) BETWEEN 1 AND 128
            AND "label" = btrim("label")
            AND "label" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
          )
        )

ddl.name: ssh_relays_gateway_instance_check
ddl.value:
(
          length(btrim("gateway_instance_id")) BETWEEN 1 AND 128
          AND "gateway_instance_id" = btrim("gateway_instance_id")
          AND "gateway_instance_id" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
        )

ddl.name: ssh_relays_closure_reason_check
ddl.value:
(
          "closure_reason" IS NULL
          OR (
            length(btrim("closure_reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 128
            AND "closure_reason" = btrim("closure_reason")
            AND "closure_reason" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
          )
        )

ddl.name: ssh_relays_state_check
ddl.value:
(
          (
            "status" = 'opening'
            AND "activated_at" IS NULL
            AND "closing_at" IS NULL
            AND "closed_at" IS NULL
            AND "closure_reason" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "status" = 'active'
            AND "activated_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "closing_at" IS NULL
            AND "closed_at" IS NULL
            AND "closure_reason" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "status" = 'closing'
            AND "closing_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "closed_at" IS NULL
            AND "closure_reason" IS NOT NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "status" = 'closed'
            AND "closing_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "closed_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "closure_reason" IS NOT NULL
          )
        )

ddl.name: ssh_relays_timestamp_check
ddl.value:
(
          "activated_at" IS NULL
          OR "activated_at" >= "opened_at"
        )
        AND
        (
          "closing_at" IS NULL
          OR "closing_at" >= "opened_at"
        )
        AND
        (
          "closed_at" IS NULL
          OR (
            "closing_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "closed_at" >= "closing_at"
          )
        )

ddl.name: ssh_tickets_hash_check
ddl.value: "ticket_hash" ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'

ddl.name: ssh_tickets_expiry_check
ddl.value: "expires_at" > "issued_at"

ddl.name: ssh_tickets_state_check
ddl.value:
(
          (
            "status" = 'issued'
            AND "redeemed_at" IS NULL
            AND "revoked_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "status" = 'redeemed'
            AND "redeemed_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "revoked_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "status" = 'revoked'
            AND "revoked_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
        )

ddl.name: ssh_tickets_timestamp_check
ddl.value:
(
          "redeemed_at" IS NULL
          OR "redeemed_at" >= "issued_at"
        )
        AND
        (
          "revoked_at" IS NULL
          OR "revoked_at" >= "issued_at"
        )
        AND
        (
          "redeemed_at" IS NULL
          OR "revoked_at" IS NULL
          OR "revoked_at" >= "redeemed_at"
        )

ddl.name: capsule_branch_previews_host_check
ddl.value:
(
          length("host") BETWEEN 3 AND 253
          AND "host" = lower("host")
          AND "host" !~ '[*><@/?#]'
          AND "host" !~ '\.$'
        )

ddl.name: capsule_branch_previews_provider_route_id_check
ddl.value: "provider_route_id" ~ '^qiln-preview-[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,113}[a-z0-9])?$'

ddl.name: capsule_branch_previews_current_configuration_check
ddl.value:
(
          (
            "current_runtime_ip" IS NULL
            AND "current_configuration_key" IS NULL
            AND "current_configuration_digest" IS NULL
            AND "current_configuration" IS NULL
            AND "applied_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "current_runtime_ip" IS NOT NULL
            AND "current_configuration_key" IS NOT NULL
            AND "current_configuration_digest" IS NOT NULL
            AND "current_configuration" IS NOT NULL
            AND jsonb_typeof("current_configuration") = 'object'
            AND "applied_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
        )

ddl.name: capsule_branch_previews_pending_configuration_check
ddl.value:
(
          (
            "pending_runtime_ip" IS NULL
            AND "pending_configuration_key" IS NULL
            AND "pending_configuration_digest" IS NULL
            AND "pending_configuration" IS NULL
            AND "apply_intent_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "pending_runtime_ip" IS NOT NULL
            AND "pending_configuration_key" IS NOT NULL
            AND "pending_configuration_digest" IS NOT NULL
            AND "pending_configuration" IS NOT NULL
            AND jsonb_typeof("pending_configuration") = 'object'
            AND "apply_intent_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
        )

ddl.name: capsule_branch_previews_current_runtime_ip_check
ddl.value: "current_runtime_ip" IS NULL OR length(btrim("current_runtime_ip")) BETWEEN 1 AND 255

ddl.name: capsule_branch_previews_pending_runtime_ip_check
ddl.value: "pending_runtime_ip" IS NULL OR length(btrim("pending_runtime_ip")) BETWEEN 1 AND 255

ddl.name: capsule_branch_previews_current_configuration_digest_check
ddl.value:
(
          "current_configuration_digest" IS NULL
          OR "current_configuration_digest" ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
        )

ddl.name: capsule_branch_previews_pending_configuration_digest_check
ddl.value:
(
          "pending_configuration_digest" IS NULL
          OR "pending_configuration_digest" ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
        )

ddl.name: capsule_branch_previews_verification_check
ddl.value:
(
          (
            "verification_intent_at" IS NULL
            AND "verification_evidence" IS NULL
            AND "verified_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "current_runtime_ip" IS NOT NULL
            AND "verification_intent_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "verification_evidence" IS NULL
            AND "verified_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "current_runtime_ip" IS NOT NULL
            AND "verification_intent_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "verification_evidence" IS NOT NULL
            AND "verified_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
        )

ddl.name: capsule_branch_previews_remove_intent_check
ddl.value:
(
          "remove_intent_at" IS NULL
          OR (
            "current_runtime_ip" IS NOT NULL
            AND "pending_runtime_ip" IS NULL
          )
        )

ddl.name: capsule_branch_previews_status_check
ddl.value:
(
          (
            "status" = 'inactive'
            AND "current_runtime_ip" IS NULL
            AND "pending_runtime_ip" IS NULL
            AND "verification_intent_at" IS NULL
            AND "verification_evidence" IS NULL
            AND "verified_at" IS NULL
            AND "remove_intent_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "status" = 'applying'
            AND "pending_runtime_ip" IS NOT NULL
            AND "remove_intent_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "status" = 'verifying'
            AND "current_runtime_ip" IS NOT NULL
            AND "pending_runtime_ip" IS NULL
            AND "verification_intent_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "verification_evidence" IS NULL
            AND "verified_at" IS NULL
            AND "remove_intent_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "status" = 'active'
            AND "current_runtime_ip" IS NOT NULL
            AND "pending_runtime_ip" IS NULL
            AND "verification_intent_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "verification_evidence" IS NOT NULL
            AND "verified_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "remove_intent_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "status" = 'degraded'
            AND "current_runtime_ip" IS NOT NULL
            AND "pending_runtime_ip" IS NULL
            AND "remove_intent_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "status" = 'removing'
            AND "current_runtime_ip" IS NOT NULL
            AND "pending_runtime_ip" IS NULL
            AND "remove_intent_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
          OR
          "status" = 'cleanup_required'
        )

ddl.name: capsule_branch_previews_failure_check
ddl.value:
(
          (
            "status" IN ('degraded', 'cleanup_required')
            AND "failure_code" IS NOT NULL
            AND "failure_message" IS NOT NULL
            AND "failure_details" IS NOT NULL
            AND "failure_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "status" NOT IN ('degraded', 'cleanup_required')
            AND "failure_code" IS NULL
            AND "failure_message" IS NULL
            AND "failure_details" IS NULL
            AND "failure_at" IS NULL
          )
        )

ddl.name: capsule_branch_previews_timestamp_order_check
ddl.value:
(
          (
            "verification_intent_at" IS NULL
            OR (
              "applied_at" IS NOT NULL
              AND "verification_intent_at" >= "applied_at"
            )
          )
          AND
          (
            "verified_at" IS NULL
            OR (
              "verification_intent_at" IS NOT NULL
              AND "verified_at" >= "verification_intent_at"
            )
          )
          AND
          (
            "remove_intent_at" IS NULL
            OR (
              "applied_at" IS NOT NULL
              AND "remove_intent_at" >= "applied_at"
            )
          )
        )

ddl.name: capsule_branch_resources_blueprint_volume_check
ddl.value:
(
          (
            "resource_type" IN ('zfs_volume', 'bind_mount')
            AND "blueprint_volume_name" IS NOT NULL
          )
          OR
          (
            "resource_type" NOT IN ('zfs_volume', 'bind_mount')
            AND "blueprint_volume_name" IS NULL
          )
        )

ddl.name: capsule_branches_runtime_error_details_check
ddl.value:
(
          "status" <> 'error'
          OR (
            "runtime_error_code" IS NOT NULL
            AND "runtime_error_message" IS NOT NULL
            AND "runtime_error_details" IS NOT NULL
            AND "runtime_error_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
        )

ddl.name: capsule_branches_inactive_runtime_ip_check
ddl.value:
(
          "status" NOT IN ('offline', 'snapshotting')

        )

ddl.name: capsule_destroy_operations_version_check
ddl.value: "schema_version" = 1

ddl.name: capsule_destroy_operations_digest_check
ddl.value: "plan_digest" ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'

ddl.name: capsule_destroy_operations_branches_check
ddl.value: cardinality("branch_ids") > 0

ddl.name: capsule_destroy_operations_count_check
ddl.value: "target_count" >= 0

ddl.name: capsule_destroy_operations_ssh_check
ddl.value:
(
          ("ssh_revocation" IS NULL AND "ssh_revoked_at" IS NULL)
          OR (
            "ssh_revocation" IS NOT NULL
            AND jsonb_typeof("ssh_revocation") = 'object'
            AND "ssh_revoked_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "ssh_revoked_at" >= "planned_at"
          )
        )

ddl.name: capsule_destroy_resources_digest_check
ddl.value: "target_digest" ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'

ddl.name: capsule_destroy_resources_documents_check
ddl.value:
(
          jsonb_typeof("target") = 'object'
          AND jsonb_typeof("proof") = 'object'
          AND ("observation_before" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("observation_before") = 'object')
          AND ("observation_after" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("observation_after") = 'object')
        )

ddl.name: capsule_destroy_resources_state_check
ddl.value:
(
          (
            "status" = 'planned'
            AND "intent_at" IS NULL
            AND "observation_after" IS NULL
            AND "verified_at" IS NULL
            AND ("observation_before" IS NULL OR ("observation_before"->>'state') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'present')
          )
          OR (
            "status" = 'deleting'
            AND "observation_before" IS NOT NULL
            AND ("observation_before"->>'state') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'present'
            AND "intent_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "observation_after" IS NULL
            AND "verified_at" IS NULL
          )
          OR (
            "status" = 'absent'
            AND "observation_before" IS NOT NULL
            AND ("observation_before"->>'state') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'absent'
            AND "intent_at" IS NULL
            AND "observation_after" IS NULL
            AND "verified_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
          OR (
            "status" = 'deleted'
            AND "observation_before" IS NOT NULL
            AND ("observation_before"->>'state') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'present'
            AND "intent_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "observation_after" IS NOT NULL
            AND ("observation_after"->>'state') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'absent'
            AND "verified_at" IS NOT NULL
          )
          OR (
            "status" = 'unresolved'
            AND "verified_at" IS NULL
          )
        )

ddl.name: capsule_destroy_resources_timeline_check
ddl.value:
(
          ("intent_at" IS NULL OR "intent_at" >= "created_at")
          AND ("observation_after" IS NULL OR "intent_at" IS NOT NULL)
          AND (
            "verified_at" IS NULL
            OR "verified_at" >= COALESCE("intent_at", "created_at")
          )
        )

ddl.name: capsule_fork_operations_blueprint_schema_check
ddl.value: "blueprint_schema_version" = 1

ddl.name: capsule_fork_operations_blueprint_digest_check
ddl.value: "blueprint_digest" ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'

ddl.name: capsule_fork_operations_inventory_digest_check

ddl.name: capsule_operations_destroy_force_check
